comments: This assertion was introduced in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/103871 but in fact it's bogus and would have been bogus before those changes too, so I'm calling this `low-risk`.

review_comments:
Did you consider changing it to:

```
assert isClosed.get() == false || failedEngine.get() != null;
```
?

I did, but it doesn't seem especially useful - it says we're either open, or closed due to a failure, but the reason for closing doesn't really matter here, AFAICT it'd be fine if we closed gracefully while running this method too.
